Hester Gray has dark hair that is easily ruffled by the wind. She is also distinguished by her soft eyes.

## History

Hester Gray was raised in the country and always possessed a strong desire to return there. Before her marriage, she worked in a [Boston](../codex/places.md#boston) store, a job she detested. She later married [Jordan](../character/jordan.md) Gray, and the couple lived together for four years.

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P51](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0051)_
